releasePlan.notes: Roles: error-rate = killswitch, latency = pause, success-rate = monitoring. The latency event is emitted on both control and v1 (server-side page render), so that comparison is two-armed. The success event, and the refresh-failure half of the error event, come from the v1 page's beacon only — control renders no refresh control and must stay byte-identical, so success-rate is one-armed and is monitoring-only. The frontend has no OpenTelemetry/observability package and the project has no otel* autogenerated metrics, so track() is the only valid guardrail backing (span_coverage: none). Both services build a hardcoded demo-user context, so a percentage rollout puts all traffic in one bucket until the context is real.
